project_title: Nginx Config Drift Tracker & ITSM (Freshdesk) Incident Command Center
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical DevOps / SRE Operations Console)

diff_viewer.style: side-by-side or unified toggle, line numbers, code syntax highlighting, copy section, collapse unchanged blocks

node_pair_card.style: card with subtle border, status pulse dot, SSH connection status indicator, quick comparison trigger CTA

incident_banner.style: high priority alert toast or bar with direct Freshdesk ticket link, status sync, and escalation actions

testing_and_accessibility.wcag_contrast: APCA high contrast dark mode compliance with minimum 4.5:1 ratio for status badges and text
testing_and_accessibility.aria_labels: Explicit labels for diff line toggles, live execution logs, and modal triggers

instructions_to_main_agent:
1. Ensure JWT auth guard wraps all dashboard routes.
2. Implement SSH live connection mock/real trigger with visual loading spinner and step logs (Connecting -> Fetching /etc/nginx -> Diffing -> Completed).
3. Provide realistic Nginx config templates (e.g. upstream blocks, server ssl settings, location /api routing) with subtle drift (e.g., worker_connections, proxy_pass port difference, SSL cipher mismatch).
4. Include Freshdesk ticket creation dialog modal allowing automated subject/description populating with drift details.
5. Keep all code clean, structured into modular components, and adhere strictly to data-testid convention.
